_what: P1.2c VERIFIED ticker->Yahoo symbol map. An entry exists ONLY where (a) an index screen, the broker, a VCI artefact, the VCI watchlist or the declared benchmark list named the ticker, AND (b) the live listing's EXCHANGE is one its declared venue permits. ⚑ A symbol match is NOT a check: a bare `ONT` returns meta.symbol 'ONT' for Onterris, Inc. The EXCHANGE is the falsifier. ⚑ REFRESHED BY THE RUN THAT CONSUMES IT (Step 5x, ISA-0577) — this file was a hand-run artefact frozen at 2026-08-28 while the universe grew every month, and 119 of 178 names (66.9%) were unmapped, unfetched and sized on A2.3's adverse 0.70. ⚑ APPEND-ONLY: an existing entry is never re-decided (R4.8). ⚑ GENERATED — never hand-edited (R14.3).
